title: 云计算和 SaaS 领域的技术、基础设施、应用层、资本信号和风险信号分析
core_insight: 云计算和 SaaS 领域正在经历技术、基础设施和应用层面的快速发展，伴随着资本信号和风险信号的变化，AWS、Salesforce、Google Cloud 和 HubSpot 等公司在技术和应用层面上持续推进云计算和 SaaS 的发展

dimension_texts.technology: AWS 推出 MicroVMs，实现了更高级别的隔离和安全；Cloudflare 推出 Smart Tiered Cache，支持多云环境的缓存优化 AWS Certificate Manager 支持 ACME 协议，自动化公钥证书的颁发和更新；Cloudflare 研究院推出 Meerkat 共识服务，采用 QuePaxa 算法实现全球共识 AWS Weekly Roundup: One-click Lambda setup prompt, OpenAI GPT-5.6 models on Bedrock, and more Run isolated sandboxes with full lifecycle control: AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs Improving Smart Tiered Cache for Public Cloud Regions Introducing Meerkat: an experiment in global consensus
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS EC2 C9g 和 C9gd 实例推出，提供更高的计算性能；Cloudflare 推出 Internal DNS AWS Graviton5 处理器的应用；AMD 推出 ROCm.AI Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now available Cloudflare Internal DNS is now generally available AMD vibe codes its way past the CUDA moat with ROCm.AI
